_about: Mages City join criteria, in registration order. Each entry is the body of one vtc/schemas/accepts/register/0.2 document. Shape follows docs/03-vtc/join-criteria.md at VTI origin/main (observed 2026-10-07); VALIDATE against the spec at the pinned revision before registering — field names here are the doc's, not a tested payload. Order matters: a criterion that requires nothing goes LAST.
_register: console: Vetting → Requirements; or a signed vtc/schemas/accepts/register/0.2 document per entry. Upstream defaults ship invited + member-credential + review; remove member-credential (no trust registry yet), then register arena-evidence so the order reads invited · arena-evidence · review.

criteria.description: An invitation this community issued. The City's gate issues one only after VALIDATED (understanding) and a human countersign.

An Arena run brought for review: the applicant attaches the chronicle carrying its Evidence root and the submission note. Review by a human admitter; approval mints membership and a role credential naming the lane. No credential requirement in protocol; the review reads the record.
Everyone else. A human decides; pending grants nothing.

_notRegistered.member-credential: upstream default, removed: credentialIssuers=recognised needs a trust registry the City has not chosen; credentialIssuers=community would only admit existing members.
_notRegistered.vetting: peer vetting / hidden vetters: a later decision once there are members to vet.
